name: Victoria University of Wellington
description: Victoria University of Wellington (Te Herenga Waka) is a public research university in Wellington, New Zealand's capital, founded in 1897 as Victoria College. Its faculties span law, humanities, science, engineering and business.
whyIncluded: Its LLB is one of only two New Zealand law degrees on the Singapore Institute of Legal Education's list of approved overseas universities (graduates in the top 70% of their cohort), and New Zealand is among the ten destinations with the most Singaporean students abroad (about 360 in the UNESCO Institute for Statistics (UIS; UNESCO is the United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization) data for 2022-24).

livingCosts.notes: Victoria University of Wellington 'Money Matters 2026' example budget for a student in a hall of residence, 40 weeks at the 2026 rate, weekly x 52/12. Housing: catered room $578/wk (electricity, internet and meals included), so food is 0 because it is inside the room rate. Transport: $10/wk. Personal: mobile phone $15 + toiletries $15 + personal spending $70/wk. The example's weekly total is $688 ($27,520 for 40 weeks); excludes occasional costs (holiday travel, laptop, textbooks), insurance, visa and airfare. The guide's overall estimate is $20,000-$33,000 for 40 weeks.

programmes.notes: 2027 international undergraduate Science rate $357.43 per point x 120 points (the university's 'average year of full-time study'); COMP courses are in the Science fee band (Fees Schedule 2027). 360 points = 3 years. Compulsory = 2027 Student Services Fee $10.64/point x 120 ($1,276.80) + Student Hardship Fee $33 (wgtn.ac.nz/students/money/fees/student-services-fee). 2026 = 2026 Science rate $337.20 x 120 with SSF $10.44 x 120 + $32. Excludes insurance. Fees reviewed annually.
